get.summary: Aggregate API health for the web app shell.
Runtime configuration for the SPA (Entra sign-in values, or null when sign-in is unavailable; map settings).

post.summary: Creates a 24 h guest account with demo data and returns its bearer token.

put.summary: Updates the caller's profile (display name, time zone, units).

get.summary: The month grid (Monday-first) with the caller's runs and ISO-week totals.
Searches places by name (provider-neutral). 503 feature-unavailable when no geocoding provider is configured.
The caller's runs in an inclusive date range (at most 92 days).

post.summary: Creates a planned or completed run for the caller.

get.summary: One of the caller's runs. Other users' runs are indistinguishable from missing ones (404).

put.summary: Replaces one of the caller's runs. 'version' must match the current one, otherwise 409.

delete.summary: Deletes one of the caller's runs and its tracks, files first. If the files cannot be deleted nothing is removed (503).

post.summary: Uploads a GPX file as the run's planned course or recorded track; it is parsed, measured and stored synchronously.

get.summary: One track of one of the caller's runs, with its summary once processed. Anything else is 404.

delete.summary: Deletes a track and its stored files. If the files cannot be deleted nothing is removed (503).

get.summary: The processed track (simplified line, start/finish, elevation profile, splits) as GeoJSON. Immutable per track id.
The original uploaded GPX file as an attachment.

Bearer.description: Entra External ID access token (scope access_as_user) or a guest token from POST /api/guest-sessions.
